DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんばんは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good evening. Can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計をお願いしましたが、この伝票は私たちの注文と違うようです。支払う前に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払い前に伝票の注文内容が違うと確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I asked for the bill, but this doesn't seem to match our order. Could you check before I pay?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to have the order on the bill checked before paying because it is different. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの点が違っていますか。お席も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: What is different? Please also tell me where you were sitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 窓側の二人席です。飲み物はお茶二杯だけでしたが、伝票にはビール三杯があります。別の卓の物かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓側二人席の飲物はお茶二杯なのに伝票へビール三杯があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The table for two by the window. Our only drinks were two teas, but this bill has three beers. It may belong to another table.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you were at the window table for two and had two teas, but the bill lists three beers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 伝票の卓番号を確認します。お客様が飲んでいない物を削除する前に、伝票自体が合っているか調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the table number on the bill. Before deleting items you didn't drink, I'll check whether the bill itself is yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、ビールだけ消すとほかの料理も違うままになるかもしれません。二人席の注文記録と照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲物だけ削除せず二人席の注文記録との照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, if you only delete the beers, the other dishes might still be wrong. Please compare it with the order record for our table for two.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for comparison with your table's order record rather than just deleting the drinks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の卓の伝票でした。こちらが二人席の伝票です。内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It was another table's bill. Here is the bill for your table for two. Please check the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お茶二杯と焼き魚、冷ややっこが載っています。この三つは注文しました。先ほどの伝票は使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正しい伝票の三品を確認し旧伝票を使わないよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It lists two teas, grilled fish, and chilled tofu. We ordered those three items. Please don't use the previous bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the three items on the correct bill and say not to use the old bill. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの伝票で会計します。お二人で分けてお支払いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll use this bill for payment. Will the two of you pay separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は私がまとめて払います。正しい伝票の金額を確認してからカードを出します。訂正後のレシートもお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分がまとめてカードで払い訂正後レシートを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay for everything today. I'll check the amount on the correct bill before handing over my card. Please give me the corrected receipt, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay for everything by card and request the corrected receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの伝票でまとめてお会計し、レシートをお渡しします。確認のお声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take one payment using this bill and give you the receipt. Thank you for checking with us.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。作業で何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with the work?

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて収穫した野菜を写真に残したいです。ただ、箱を運ぶ途中に電話を出すのでなく、作業が区切れた時に撮ってよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初収穫を撮影したいが箱運搬中でなく作業区切りで許可を聞きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a photo of the vegetables I harvested for the first time. But instead of taking out my phone while carrying boxes, I'd like to ask if I may take one at a break in the work.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to photograph your first harvest and ask permission at a pause in the work rather than while carrying boxes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮りたいのは、野菜だけですか。作業中の人も入る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you want to photograph just the vegetables, or will people working be in the photo, too?

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 野菜と自分の手元だけです。ほかの人を撮るつもりはありませんが、箱の奥に人が映らないかも確認します。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 野菜と自分の手元だけ撮り他人が奥に映らぬか確認すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just the vegetables and my hands. I don't intend to photograph anyone else, but I'll also check that nobody appears behind the boxes.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will photograph only the vegetables and your hands and check that nobody appears in the background. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休憩前に箱を置き終えてから、担当へ撮影してよいか確認してください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-05.translation: After finishing putting down the boxes before the break, ask the person in charge whether photography is allowed.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱を決められた場所へ運び終えてから聞きます。今の手袋で電話へ触らず、休憩の準備をしてから取り出します。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱運搬後に許可を聞き手袋で電話に触らず休憩準備後出すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask after carrying the boxes to the designated place. I won't touch my phone with these gloves; I'll get ready for the break before taking it out.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask permission after carrying the boxes and take out the phone after preparing for the break, without touching it with your gloves. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影のために、選別前の野菜を別の箱へ移さないでください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't move unsorted vegetables into another box for the photo.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。きれいな物だけを並べ替えるのでなく、許可された位置から今の箱を撮ります。写る札も見せてよいか聞きます。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 選別前野菜を並替えず許可位置で撮り札の表示可否も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. Rather than rearrange only the nice-looking ones, I'll photograph the current box from an approved position. I'll also ask whether any labels in view may be shown.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you won't rearrange unsorted vegetables, will photograph from an approved position, and will check whether labels may appear. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に短く撮れます。撮り終えたら、作業へ戻る前に電話をしまってください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, you can take a quick photo. Put your phone away afterward, before returning to work.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作業を終えた区切りで許可を聞き、周りの人と札が写らない構図を選びます。撮影後は電話をしまって次の指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区切りで許可を得て人札を避け撮影後電話をしまい次指示を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask permission at a break in the work and choose a composition without nearby people or labels. After taking the photo, I'll put my phone away and wait for the next instructions.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will get permission at a work break, avoid people and labels, put the phone away after the photo, and await instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 作業と撮影を分ける相談ですね。担当に確認してから進めましょう。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-001-SHARED-11.translation: You'd like to keep photography separate from work, then. Let's check with the person in charge first. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。野菜選びのお手伝いをしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. May I help you choose vegetables?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 量り売りのいんげんを、自分の家と隣の家の分で買いたいです。合計を量った後で半分にするのでなく、別々に量れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自宅隣人用いんげんを合計後分割せず別々に量りたいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to buy green beans by weight for my household and my neighbor's. Could you weigh them separately rather than weighing the total and dividing it in half?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to weigh green beans for yourself and your neighbor separately rather than dividing a combined weight afterward. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それぞれどのくらい必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: How much does each household need?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: うちは三百グラム、隣は二百グラムです。料理を一緒に作るわけではないので、袋も分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自宅三百グラム隣二百グラムで調理も袋も別と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Three hundred grams for us and two hundred for the neighbor. We're not cooking together, so I'd also like separate bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that your household needs three hundred grams and the neighbor two hundred, with separate cooking and bags. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二袋に分けて量れます。多少前後しますが、重さを見て調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can weigh them in two separate bags. The weights may vary slightly, but we'll check and adjust them.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。隣の分を多く取りすぎたら、自分の分へ黙って移すのでなく、こちらで重さを調整していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 隣分が多ければ自己移動でなく店で計量調整してほしいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. If there's too much in the neighbor's portion, rather than quietly moving some to mine myself, I'll have you adjust the weight here.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that if the neighbor's portion is too large, you would like the shop to adjust it by weighing rather than moving it yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず三百グラムの方を量りました。こちらが二百グラムの方です。分かるよう印を付けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've weighed the three-hundred-gram portion first. Here is the two-hundred-gram one. Would you like a mark to distinguish them?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 袋に重さを書いたラベルがあれば助かります。自分用を隣へ渡さないよう、会計後も二つを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 重さラベルを求め会計後も渡す袋を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Labels showing the weight would help. Even after checkout, I'll check both so I don't give my own portion to the neighbor.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request weight labels and say that you will check which bag to hand over even after checkout. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 重さのラベルを貼ります。お支払いも別々でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll attach weight labels. Will the payments also be separate?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 支払いは私がまとめます。袋は別ですが、会計まで二つに分ける必要はありません。隣には二百グラムの袋を渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 支払いは一括だが袋は別で隣へ二百グラムを渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll pay for everything together. The bags are separate, but there's no need to split the payment too. I'll give the two-hundred-gram bag to the neighbor.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that payment is combined but the bags are separate and that you will give your neighbor two hundred grams. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 三百グラムと二百グラムを別袋で、会計はまとめます。お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Three hundred grams and two hundred grams in separate bags, with one payment. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご乗船について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Can I help you with boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 船から景色を見ながらこの地図を使いたいです。広げると大きいので、乗る前に見たい部分だけ出しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 船上で地図を使うため必要部分だけ出して準備したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to use this map while looking at the scenery from the boat. It's large when unfolded, so I'd like to expose only the part I need before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about preparing a map for use on the boat with only the necessary section showing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 航路が載っている地図ですね。どの辺りを見たいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's a map showing the boat route, then. Which area would you like to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 出発地点と対岸の建物です。全部を広げず、この二つが同時に見えるよう折りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 出発地点と対岸建物を一緒に見えるよう折りたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The departure point and a building on the opposite shore. I'd like to fold it so I can see both at once without spreading out the whole map.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you want to fold the map to show the departure point and opposite-shore building together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの台で準備できます。船内では風があるため、紙が飛ばないよう持ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can prepare it at this counter. It can be windy on board, so please hold the paper securely so it doesn't blow away.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 地図は透明の袋へ入れます。写真を撮る時は地図をかばんにしまい、両方を一度に手に持たないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 地図を透明袋へ入れ写真時はかばんにしまうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll put the map in a transparent bag. When taking photos, I'll put it in my bag rather than hold both at the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the map in a transparent sleeve and pack it away when taking photos. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乗り降りの時も、手荷物をまとめてください。お連れ様はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please keep your belongings together when boarding and disembarking, too. Are you traveling with anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一人です。地図を見るため立ち止まらず、乗って席に着いてから取り出します。途中で建物が分からなければ案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 一人で席に着いてから地図を出し景色案内も聞きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm alone. Rather than stop to read the map, I'll take it out after boarding and sitting down. If I can't identify a building along the way, I'd like to ask for information.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you are alone, will take out the map after sitting down, and would also like information about the scenery. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 景色の説明があるかは担当へ確認します。乗船の列が動いたら、地図をしまってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll ask the staff whether scenery commentary is available. When the boarding queue moves, put your map away and move forward.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 今ここで二つの目印を確認して折ります。列ではかばんへ入れ、席に着いてから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 列が動く前に目印を確認し乗降時は地図をしまうと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll check the two landmarks here now and fold the map. I'll keep it in my bag in the queue and take it out once seated.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will check the landmarks before the queue moves and put the map away when boarding and disembarking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 乗船前に台をお使いください。案内については担当へつなぎます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please use the counter before boarding. I'll refer you to the staff for information. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二人分を注文したいのですが、子どもの手を引いているので、熱いうどん二つを一度に運ぶのは難しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 子の手を引き熱いうどん二つを一度に運べないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to order for two, but I'm holding my child's hand, so carrying two hot bowls of udon at once would be difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you are holding your child's hand and cannot carry two hot udon bowls at once. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お子様とお二人ですね。お席はもう決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's you and your child, then. Have you chosen a table yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 奥の席です。子どもを一人で残したくないので、一緒に移動できる受取り方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 奥の席で子を一人にせず移動できる受取り方を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: At the back. I don't want to leave my child alone, so I'd like to discuss how to collect the food while moving together.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask how to collect the food and go to your table at the back without leaving your child alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先に一つを受け取り、もう一つをこちらでお待たせする方法もあります。係が運べるかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: You could collect one first and have us hold the other here. I'll also check whether a staff member can carry one.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 係の方に運べるか確認していただけますか。難しければ、二つを急いで持たず、受取りの順を考え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 係の運搬可否を聞き難しければ受取り順を再検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you check whether the staff can carry one? If that isn't possible, rather than rush to carry both, I'll reconsider the collection order.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether staff can carry one and say that if not, you will reconsider the collection sequence. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一つは係がお席へ運べます。お客様はもう一つのトレーだけお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: A staff member can carry one to your table. Please carry only the other tray yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 助かります。子どもの分は係の方へお願いし、私は自分の分を持ちます。飲物までトレーに載せず、後で取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 子の分を係へ頼み自分の一つだけ運び飲物は後にすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: That helps. Please have the staff take my child's portion, and I'll carry mine. I won't add drinks to the tray; I'll get them later.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask staff to carry your child's portion, say you will carry only your own, and leave drinks until later. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。お席の位置を係にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. Please tell the staff where your table is.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 奥の壁側の二人席です。先に二人で席へ行き、飲物は落ち着いてから取りに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 壁側二人席を伝え着席後落ち着いて飲物を取ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: It's the table for two by the wall at the back. We'll go to the table together first, and I'll come for drinks once we're settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Describe the wall-side table for two and say you will get drinks after sitting down and settling in. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お子様の分は係がその席へお持ちします。ゆっくりお進みください。ご注文ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: A staff member will bring your child's portion to that table. Please move at your own pace. Thank you for your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 母が拾った財布を届けたそうですが、どの交番か聞き取れませんでした。本人へ確認するため、この交番の呼び方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 母の拾得物届出先を聞き直すため交番名称を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: My mother says she handed in a wallet she found, but I couldn't catch which police box. Please tell me the name of this police box so I can check with her.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask the police box's name so you can ask your mother again where she handed in the lost property. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの名称をお伝えします。お母様が届けたことを確認してほしいというご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll give you our name. Would you like us to confirm that your mother handed it in here?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今は個人の届出内容を教えてほしいのではありません。まず母に場所を聞き直し、必要なら本人から連絡してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 個人の届出内容ではなく場所を母へ確認したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm not asking for details of an individual's report now. First I'll ask my mother the location again, and if necessary, have her contact you herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to check the location with your mother, not obtain personal report details. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。場所の説明も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Do you need directions as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、駅からこちらへ来る時の目印を知りたいです。母は建物の名前より、道の角の特徴を覚えていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 母が覚えやすい駅からの位置と目印を知りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I'd like landmarks on the way here from the station. I think my mother remembers features of street corners better than building names.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you would like the location and landmarks from the station that your mother can remember easily. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 入口の案内図で位置を確認できます。ここに書かれた名称と位置をお母様へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can check the location on the map at the entrance. Please tell your mother the name and location shown here.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 案内図を見て、名称と位置をメモします。財布の持ち主を私が探して連絡することはせず、届出先の確認だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 名称と位置をメモし持ち主探しでなく届出先だけ確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll look at the map and note the name and location. I won't try to find and contact the wallet's owner myself; I'll only check where it was handed in.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the name and location and only check the reporting location rather than search for the owner. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 届出の相談が残る場合は、お母様から担当へお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: If there are further questions about the report, your mother can ask the responsible staff herself.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 母に名称と位置を伝えます。違う場所ならその交番を本人に確認し、届けた後の相談も本人からしてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 母へ場所を伝え別交番なら本人に確認し相談も本人から行うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll tell my mother the name and location. If it was somewhere else, I'll have her confirm that police box and also make any follow-up inquiries herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your mother the location, have her check if it was a different police box, and have her make any inquiries herself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 場所の確認ですね。案内図をご覧ください。お問い合わせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: You're checking the location, then. Please look at the map. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。準備で何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Can I help with the preparations?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 掲示用の案内図と机の配置が違います。今の図を貼ってよいか、担当に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 案内図と机配置が違うので掲示前に確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The information map for display doesn't match the desk layout. I'd like to check with the person in charge whether I can post the current map.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to check before posting because the map and desk layout differ. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どの部分が違っていますか。お持ちの図を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Which part is different? Please show me your map.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この図では受付が入口の右ですが、今は左に机があります。図の日付は昨日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 昨日の図は受付右だが現場は左と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: On this map, reception is to the right of the entrance, but the desk is now on the left. The map is dated yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that yesterday's map shows reception on the right but it is on the left on site. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 配置変更後の図があるか確認します。まだ掲示していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check whether there is a map updated after the layout change. You haven't posted it yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一枚だけ仮に置きましたが、固定はしていません。来場者が見る前に回収し、残りもまとめて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未固定の仮置き一枚を回収し残りも掲示せず待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I put one copy down temporarily, but haven't fixed it in place. I'll collect it before visitors see it and keep the remaining copies together while waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will collect the one unfixed temporary copy and wait without posting the rest. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 更新版が届きました。右下に本日の日付があります。置く前に入口との向きも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The updated version has arrived. Today's date is at the bottom right. Before placing it, let's also check its orientation relative to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。紙の上下が合っていても、見る人の立つ場所が違うと左右を間違えそうです。掲示場所から入口を見て確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 更新図を掲示場所から入口を見て左右確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. Even if the paper is the right way up, left and right could be confusing depending on where the viewer stands. I'll check by looking toward the entrance from the posting location.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check left and right on the updated map by looking toward the entrance from the posting location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認後は古い図と新しい図を混ぜないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: After checking, please don't mix the old and new maps.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 昨日の日付の図は別に束ねます。今日の図を掲示位置で見比べ、受付の左右が合うことを確認してから貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 旧図を別に束ね今日の図の方向を確認後に掲示すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll bundle the maps dated yesterday separately. I'll compare today's map from the posting position and put it up after confirming that reception is shown on the correct side.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will bundle the old maps separately and post today's map after checking its orientation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 旧版の回収と更新版の確認でお願いします。気付いていただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please collect the old version and check the updated one. Thank you for noticing.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんばんは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Good evening. Can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この弁当を温めてほしかったのですが、私の返事がはっきりしなかったかもしれません。会計は済んだので、加熱だけお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会計済み弁当について曖昧な返事を説明し加熱だけ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I wanted this bento heated, but perhaps my answer wasn't clear. I've already paid. Could you just heat it for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain your unclear answer about an already paid-for bento and ask only for heating. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認します。袋からお弁当を出していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check. Could you take the bento out of the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、これです。一緒に買った冷たいデザートは袋に残します。二つとも温めたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 弁当を出し冷たいデザートは加熱不要と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, here it is. I'll leave the chilled dessert I bought with it in the bag. I don't want both heated.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Take out the bento and distinguish the chilled dessert, which does not need heating. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お弁当だけですね。加熱する間、こちらで少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Just the bento, then. Please wait here a moment while it heats.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。急いでいたので、さっき温めるか聞かれた時、聞こえずにうなずいてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 急いでいて加熱確認を聞き取れずうなずいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. I was in a hurry, so when you asked about heating earlier, I nodded without catching what you said.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you were in a hurry and nodded without hearing the heating question clearly. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。次は聞き取れなければ、もう一度お尋ねください。お箸はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Next time, if you don't catch it, please ask again. Do you have chopsticks?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一膳あります。追加はいりません。弁当と冷たいデザートを別に持てるよう、袋の中で離して入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 箸は一膳あり追加不要で冷たい物と離して持つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have one pair. I don't need any more. I'll keep the bento and chilled dessert apart in the bag so I can carry them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you have one pair of chopsticks, need no extra, and will carry the hot food apart from the chilled item. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 温まりました。熱いので底を持つ時にお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's heated. It's hot, so be careful when holding the bottom.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: トレーの端を持って受け取ります。デザートとは離して入れ、家に着いたら袋から出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 熱いトレーの端で受取りデザートと離して帰宅後出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll take it by the edge of the tray. I'll pack it apart from the dessert and take it out of the bag when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the hot tray by its edge, keep it apart from the dessert, and unpack it at home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お弁当だけ加熱しました。お足元にお気を付けて。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've heated only the bento. Watch your step. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談の受付で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Can I help you at the consultation reception desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日相談する資料に、前年の物が混ざっています。申告書へ書き写す前に、対象年を分けて担当へ見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 税相談資料に前年分が混ざり対象年を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Some documents from the previous year are mixed in with the materials for today's consultation. Before copying figures onto the tax return, I'd like to separate them by year and show the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that previous-year documents are mixed into your tax consultation materials and that you want to separate the relevant years. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 資料に年の記載はありますか。何が混ざっているか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are the years shown on the documents? Please tell me what has been mixed together.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 勤務先から受け取った書類が二年分あります。同じ形なので、一緒の収入として足さないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 勤務先書類が二年分あり一緒に足さないようにしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have two years of documents from my employer. They look the same, so I want to avoid adding them together as one income total.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you have employer documents for two years and want to avoid adding them together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず年を確認して分けましょう。前年の書類は参考に持って来られた物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's check the years and separate them first. Did you bring the previous-year documents for reference?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、違いを聞くために持って来ました。今日の対象年の束と、前年の参考用の束に分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 前年は比較用で対象年と参考用の二束に分けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I brought them to ask about the differences. I'll make one bundle for today's relevant year and another for the previous year as reference.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that the previous year is for comparison and that you will make separate relevant-year and reference bundles. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受付では税額の判断はできませんが、対象年と資料の区別を担当へ伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Reception cannot decide the tax amount, but we can tell the staff about the relevant year and the distinction between the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それでお願いします。数字が違う理由はまだ分からないので、前年が誤りだったと決めず、二つを比べて質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 数値差の理由は未確認なので前年の誤りと決めず質問すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. I don't yet know why the numbers differ, so I won't assume the previous year was wrong. I'll compare the two and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that the reason for the different figures is unconfirmed and you will ask without assuming the previous year was wrong. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 質問したい点をメモすると相談が進めやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Making a note of your questions will help the consultation proceed smoothly.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 対象年を表紙に書き、前年との違いを知りたいとメモします。どの数値を使うかは担当に確認してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 表紙に対象年を書き差を質問し使用数値は担当確認後記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll write the relevant year on the cover and note that I want to understand the differences from the previous year. I'll check with the staff which figures to use before filling them in.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will label the cover with the year, ask about the differences, and fill in figures only after checking with the staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 対象年と参考資料を区別するご相談で承りました。担当へご案内します。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUCHIURA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've noted your request to distinguish the relevant year from reference materials. I'll direct you to the staff. Thank you.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展示の見学で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with visiting the exhibits?

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが自由研究に使うメモを取りました。磁石、音、影の三つがありますが、全部を少しずつ紹介するより、一つの問いに絞る相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 磁石音影の三メモを全部浅く紹介せず自由研究の問いを一つに絞る相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child took notes for an independent research project. There are three topics—magnets, sound, and shadows—but rather than briefly introduce all of them, we'd like advice on narrowing it to one question.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice on narrowing the three sets of magnet, sound, and shadow notes to one research question rather than covering them all superficially. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三つのうち、お子様が特に気にしていることは何ですか。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of those three, what is your child particularly curious about?

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 影の大きさが変わる所です。私は磁石を勧めましたが、子どもが自分で疑問を持った影の方を中心にしたいです。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 親の勧めた磁石より子自身が疑問を持つ影の大きさを中心にしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-04.translation: How the size of shadows changes. I suggested magnets, but I'd like to focus on the shadows my child became curious about independently.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to focus on the shadow sizes your child questioned rather than the magnets you suggested. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の疑問からまとめるのですね。展示の説明と、実際に見て気付いたことは、メモで区別されていますか。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the project will start from your child's own question. Do the notes distinguish the exhibit's explanation from what your child actually observed?

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は同じページです。「展示の説明」と「自分で見たこと」を別の見出しに分けます。自分が考えた説明のように、掲示の言葉を全部写すことはしません。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 展示説明と自分の観察を別見出しにし掲示全文を自説として写さないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-06.translation: They're on the same page now. We'll separate them under headings for 'the exhibit's explanation' and 'what I observed.' We won't copy all the display text as though it were an explanation we came up with ourselves.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate exhibit explanations and personal observations under different headings and not copy the entire display as your own theory. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引用や参考にした説明があれば、展示名を控えておくと整理できます。この展示は「光と影の広場」です。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you quote or refer to explanations, noting the exhibit name will help organize the sources. This exhibit is called 'Light and Shadow Plaza.'

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その展示名を控えます。写真を並べるだけでなく、どの時に影が大きく見えたかを、自分の観察として短く書きたいです。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 光と影の広場という参考展示名を控え写真だけでなく影が大きい時の観察を書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll note that exhibit name. Rather than just arrange photos, we'd like to write briefly, as our own observation, when the shadows looked larger.
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the reference exhibit name 'Light and Shadow Plaza' and write observations of when shadows looked larger, not just include photos. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原因が分からない部分は質問として残せます。磁石と音のメモは捨てる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can leave points whose causes you don't understand as questions. Are you planning to discard the magnet and sound notes?

DLG-SC-IBR-TSUKUBA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
